n01.title: Note tucked under a jerry can
n01.text: Count the jerry cans. I left four.

n02.title: Note on the table
n02.text: If the heater grille goes dark while the lights are on, it isn't the heater. It's the breaker. Panel's in the generator room. — V.

n03.title: Note taped beside the breaker panel
n03.text: The generator won't catch first time when it's this cold. Keep cranking. It always catches in the end. Don't go outside to look at it.

n04.title: Note under the met console keyboard
n04.text: North minus south. That's the only number that matters. If it goes past ten, keep the lights on.

n05.title: Note pinned inside the bedroll
n05.text: If you hear me outside, it isn't me. I'm in here, by the generator. I'm always in here now. — V.

n06.title: Note nailed up in the fuel shed
n06.text: Tether checked, Day 14. Seven posts from the airlock to the mast. If you count eight, turn round.

n07.title: Note on the window sill
n07.text: The handprints are on the inside of the glass. Small hands. Don't wipe them off. It counts that as an answer.

n08.title: Note on Vance's pillow
n08.text: Hollis kept count. Three knocks, never four. The night there were four, he went. So if you hear a fourth knock, sit on your hands.

n09.title: Note in the mast's instrument box
n09.text: North gauge 23 under. If you are reading this at the mast, go back now. The light isn't the helicopter. The helicopter doesn't come until six.

n10.title: Note taped to the radio
n10.text: Imogen never says a keeper's name on air. Service rules. If the radio knows your name, put the handset down.
